runtime.packagesNote: RDKit stopped publishing macOS x86_64 wheels after 2025.9.3; Intel Macs pin that release.
runtime.network: PyPI download once, at first start of this plugin's server; computations never use the network

artifacts.payload: ketcher handoff {title, smiles} per molecule: exactly the input of Agentlas Science's smiles-to-ketcher; full view adds an RDKit V2000 molfile

artifacts.files: agentlas-medchem/<name>-<hash>.svg and .png beneath the run's working folder

limitations: Properties are RDKit calculations (Crippen cLogP, Ertl TPSA, Bickerton QED), not measurements.
Rule filters (Lipinski, Veber, Egan, Ghose) and structural alerts (PAINS, Brenk) are triage heuristics; covalent warheads are flagged by Brenk as reactive groups by design.
Standardization uses RDKit MolStandardize (cleanup, largest fragment, uncharge, optional canonical tautomer); it does not resolve stereochemistry that the input does not specify.
The first call after installation may wait while RDKit is downloaded once from PyPI; the result says so.
